name: Paver patio
summary: Interlocking paver patios priced from area, pattern waste, base depth, edge restraint and haul-away.

items.label: Excavate and haul spoils
items.source: 12x16 ft patio (index.html); dig 6 in base + 1 in bedding + 2.375 in paver = 9.375 in = 0.02894 cu yd/sq ft at 2 cu yd/h; haul-away $55/cu yd, haul checked (index.html defaults, calc.mjs formulas)

items.label: Gravel base and bedding sand
items.source: 6 in gravel at $48/cu yd + 1 in bedding sand at $52/cu yd per sq ft (index.html defaults); the specialist puts base placement inside install hours

items.label: Lay running-bond pavers and polymeric sand
items.source: 0.08 h/finished sq ft x pattern factor 1; pavers $4.50/sq ft x 1.07 (7% running-bond waste) + polymeric sand 3 bags (80 sq ft/bag, rounded up) x $28 over 192 sq ft (index.html, PATTERN_PRESETS)

items.label: Edge restraint
items.source: Perimeter 2 x (12 + 16) = 56 lf (patioPerimeterLf in calc.mjs); 0.05 h and $3.75 per foot (index.html)

specialistModels: Pattern waste and cut-labor factors, base depth by use (patio vs driveway), excavation volume from total depth, and whole-bag polymeric sand.
